course.title: Introduction to Business and Markets
course.description: An accessible introduction to how markets function, covering supply and demand, price mechanisms, and the role of firms and consumers in the modern economy.
course.entryRequirements: Minimum 5 GCSEs at grade C/4 or above including English and Mathematics. No prior business knowledge required.

course.title: Quantitative Methods for Business
course.description: Builds the mathematical and statistical foundations needed for undergraduate finance and economics, covering algebra, statistics, data interpretation and financial arithmetic.
course.entryRequirements: Minimum 5 GCSEs at grade C/4 or above including English and Mathematics.

course.title: Academic English and Communication
course.description: Develops the written and oral communication skills essential for university-level study, including essay writing, critical reading, and academic presentation.
course.entryRequirements: IELTS 5.5 overall (no component below 5.0) for international students.

course.title: Principles of Accounting
course.description: An introduction to double-entry bookkeeping, financial statements, and basic management accounting preparing students for undergraduate accounting modules.
course.entryRequirements: Minimum 5 GCSEs at grade C/4 or above including Mathematics.

course.title: BSc Business and Finance
course.description: Our flagship degree combining financial theory, strategic management, and applied economics with immersive industry placements.
course.entryRequirements: AAB at A-Level; GCSE Grade B in Mathematics; IELTS 6.5 for international students.

course.title: BSc Accounting and Financial Management
course.description: A professionally focused degree aligned with ICAEW, ACCA and CIMA accreditation pathways covering financial reporting, audit, taxation and management accounting.
course.entryRequirements: AAB at A-Level; GCSE Grade B in Mathematics; IELTS 6.5 for international students.

course.title: BSc Economics and Investment
course.description: Blends economic theory with applied investment analysis developing quantitative skills alongside a deep understanding of macro and microeconomic policy.
course.entryRequirements: ABB at A-Level including Mathematics; IELTS 6.5 for international students.

course.title: BSc International Business and Marketing
course.description: Examines global commerce, cross-cultural management, digital marketing, and international trade law within a comparative international framework.
course.entryRequirements: ABB at A-Level; IELTS 6.5 for international students.

course.title: BSc Banking and Risk Management
course.description: Specialist preparation for careers in financial services covering credit risk, Basel regulation, derivatives, and the structure of global banking systems.
course.entryRequirements: AAB at A-Level including Mathematics; IELTS 6.5 for international students.

course.title: BSc Business Management and Strategy
course.description: Develops strategic thinking, leadership capability and entrepreneurial judgement with modules in operations, HR, innovation, and corporate governance.
course.entryRequirements: ABB at A-Level; IELTS 6.5 for international students.

course.title: MSc Financial Management
course.description: An intensive programme covering advanced corporate finance, asset pricing, portfolio management, and quantitative methods for financial decision-making.
course.entryRequirements: Minimum 2:1 Bachelor degree in a relevant subject; IELTS 7.0; two references required.

course.title: MSc Banking and International Finance
course.description: Examines global banking operations, financial regulation, central bank policy, foreign exchange markets, and the architecture of international capital flows.
course.entryRequirements: Minimum 2:1 Bachelor degree; IELTS 7.0; two references required.

course.title: MSc Strategic Management
course.description: Develops senior leadership and strategic reasoning covering competitive strategy, innovation management, mergers and acquisitions, and corporate transformation.
course.entryRequirements: Minimum 2:1 Bachelor degree; IELTS 7.0; two references required.

course.title: MSc Marketing Analytics and Commerce
course.description: Combines marketing strategy with data analytics covering digital commerce, consumer insights, programmatic advertising, and marketing technology platforms.
course.entryRequirements: Minimum 2:1 Bachelor degree; IELTS 7.0; two references required.

course.title: MBA Master of Business Administration
course.description: Full-time MBA designed for professionals with three or more years of experience combining leadership development, strategy, finance, and a major consultancy project.
course.entryRequirements: Minimum 2:1 degree; 3 or more years professional experience; IELTS 7.0; two references required.

course.title: MRes Business and Finance Research
course.description: A research-focused masters degree providing advanced training in qualitative and quantitative research methods designed as preparation for doctoral study.
course.entryRequirements: Minimum 2:1 degree; IELTS 7.0; research proposal required.
